fields.title: Keyword List
fields.help_text: Keywords audited across the site. Each keyword can have variations that count towards the same keyword.

tabs.title: AI Instructions
tabs.description: What the model is told to do. The provider itself is configured on the AI Provider tab.

fields.title: System Instructions
fields.default_value: You are a Search Engine Optimization expert. Write a meta description for the given text for SEO purposes. The summary should be a description of the article. It must be under 200 characters. The summary should always be written in the same language as the article itself.
fields.help_text: The system prompt sent with every request.

fields.title: Keyword Instructions
fields.default_value: Take into consideration using these keywords in the meta description:
fields.help_text: Prefix used when keywords should be considered but are not mandatory.

fields.title: Forced Keyword Instructions
fields.default_value: The description MUST include at least one of these words or phrases:
fields.help_text: Prefix used when at least one keyword must appear in the result.

fields.title: Run Instructions
fields.default_value: Generate the meta description in the same language as the provided text. It must be under 200 characters.
fields.help_text: Appended to every request, after the content.

tabs.title: Output
tabs.description: Whether YoLSA writes the title and description tags into your pages.

fields.title: Output meta tags
fields.help_text: Emit the meta description, Open Graph tags and document title on single posts and pages. Automatically stays out of the way while Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO, The SEO Framework or Slim SEO is active, so two plugins never both write a description.
